a45f36fbaeccb881.lede: Sunday's Music and Makers Fest in Ouray's Fellin Park is the anchor of the weekend — four live acts running from mid-morning through late afternoon, plus an artisan market, food trucks, and a beer tent with the San Juans looking over the whole thing. Friday opens strong too, with the Farmers Market on South Oak Street and First Friday bringing Donny Morales to the Sherbino in Ridgway for a free evening of soul-acoustic-funk alongside the Art Walk through downtown.

8e0c3451ecb99a72.lede: The big one to watch this week is Thursday's Planning Commission meeting, where three Land Use Code amendments — touching forestry practices, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — are up for the Commission's recommendation before anything moves to the BOCC; if those issues matter to you, that's the room to be in. Wednesday is stacked with public meetings too, including the Board of County Commissioners work session and the Board of Trustees. On the lighter side, the week runs from a guided bike-and-brewery ride in Mountain Village through The Meditations bringing roots reggae to the Sheridan Opera House on Thursday.
